stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students compared it with modern digital scales.”?
options: The old broadcast made them understand that every generation has its own "new media."
The score did not force people to choose repairable products, but it made the choice visible.
Digital scales were faster, but the old scale made the idea of fairness visible.
The old pipe made infrastructure visible.

本文沒有陳述「The score did not force people to choose repairable products, but it made the choice visible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students compared it with modern digital scales. Digital scales were faster, but the old scale made the idea of fairness visible.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
